fuel_consumption.source_quote: A one-cent change in the cost per gallon of fuel has an impact on our operating expenses of approximately $1.2 million, based on 2002 consumption.

instrument_type_details.notes: Heating oil forward contracts (exchange traded). Strategy: hedge up to 50% of anticipated fuel needs. 10% change in fuel price changes fair value by ~$1M at Dec 31 2002. Recognized loss of $0.6M from hedging program in 2002. Company was in bankruptcy as of March 2003 filing date.

warnings: Volume not disclosed; estimated fair value sensitivity only ($1M per 10% price change); company filed for bankruptcy March 21, 2003
